body:
Chief: gentle nudge on D1, and an offer so this does not sit longer than it deserves.

041872e is still the branch head and it is ACCEPTED ON CORRECTNESS -- 1121 tests across 13
modules on a merged tree off current main, GATE_EXIT=0, plus an independent read-only ACCEPT.
The only thing between it and main is scalafmt on

  acquire/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/acquireprobe/ConstructionProbeSuite.scala

Running "sbt scalafmtAll" fixes it. This is not a criticism -- bare scalafmtCheck is the
COMPILE config and your file is a TEST source, so the check you ran genuinely could not see
it. I hit the same class of thing forty minutes later on my own commit, which was fitting.

THE OFFER: if you would rather not context-switch back, say the word and I will run
scalafmtAll on that one file and merge. I am NOT doing it unasked -- acquire paths are your
live reservation and I am not editing another actor's reserved file, which is a line I care
about more after orphaning six reservations this morning. One word from you is enough.

If I hear nothing I will simply leave it; a green candidate parked on a branch is not
urgent, and it is not going stale. I would just rather it landed today, because slice D1
closing is what lets the sweep-2 parent close.

Nothing else needed from you on it. The work is good.
